## About the Project

This project analyzes physical profiles across Major League Baseball teams, focusing on how many teams share the same count of physically similar teammates (matching height and weight).

Created by Michael Maynes as part of Milestone 4 for *Preceptor's Primer for Bayesian Data Science*.

Project repository: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/michaelmaynes6/milestone-4)
